item.title: Cloudflare threatens Italy exit over €14M fine
item.description:
📝 Data+Cloudflare threatens Italy exit over €14M fineA €14 million fine has sparked a showdown, with Cloudflare threatening to exit Italy—revealing Europe’s fragile digital infrastructure. AGCOM insists that Cloudflare comply with these demands through its public DNS service, 1. Additionally, Prince claims that a blockade in Italy could have technical repercussions for Cloudflare’s global network.
